verdict: THE A-PRESS DID NOT ROLL. The plan was delivered exactly as authored and Link never entered FRONT_ROLL at all: at the sampled frame he is in MOVE, coasting to a stop with his walk facing continued past the A-press, and TETRA IS BIT-IDENTICAL to her pre-roll position -- he never reached her, so nothing was pushed. The decomp names it: `setDoStatusBasic` (d_a_player_main.cpp:2220) sets dActStts_ATTACK_e -- the only status checkNextActionFromButton (4318) turns into procFrontRoll_init -- solely for `mStickDistance > m_HIO->mBasic.m.field_0x1C` = 0.75. This aim decodes to 0.570479, so the press was dActStts_PUT_AWAY_e (2218) and SHEATHED the sword. Session 86's delivery rolled with an aim at 0.889082, so the two runs BRACKET the threshold on the real game.
